# Global scope (root = none): count the regions held whole by each contender's tree (variable nesnd_uni_held on the head) and mark the states (variable nesnd_uni_counted).
nesnd_uni_count_regions = {
	s:STATE_GUIZHOU = {
		random_scope_state = {
			owner ?= {
				var:nesnd_uni_head ?= {
					save_scope_as = nesnd_uni_region_head
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
				any_scope_state = {
					count = all
					owner ?= {
						has_variable = nesnd_uni_head
						var:nesnd_uni_head = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
					}
				}
			}
			scope:nesnd_uni_region_head = {
				change_variable = {
					name = nesnd_uni_held
					add = 1
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner ?= {
						OR = {
							country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_GUIZHOU
							overlord ?= {
								country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_GUIZHOU
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_scope_state = {
				remove_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = nesnd_uni_region_head
	s:STATE_CHONGQING = {
		random_scope_state = {
			owner ?= {
				var:nesnd_uni_head ?= {
					save_scope_as = nesnd_uni_region_head
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
				any_scope_state = {
					count = all
					owner ?= {
						has_variable = nesnd_uni_head
						var:nesnd_uni_head = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
					}
				}
			}
			scope:nesnd_uni_region_head = {
				change_variable = {
					name = nesnd_uni_held
					add = 1
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner ?= {
						OR = {
							country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_CHONGQING
							overlord ?= {
								country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_CHONGQING
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_scope_state = {
				remove_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = nesnd_uni_region_head
	s:STATE_SICHUAN = {
		random_scope_state = {
			owner ?= {
				var:nesnd_uni_head ?= {
					save_scope_as = nesnd_uni_region_head
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
				any_scope_state = {
					count = all
					owner ?= {
						has_variable = nesnd_uni_head
						var:nesnd_uni_head = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
					}

				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
				any_scope_state = {
					count = all
					owner ?= {
						has_variable = nesnd_uni_head
						var:nesnd_uni_head = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
					}
				}
			}
			scope:nesnd_uni_region_head = {
				change_variable = {
					name = nesnd_uni_held
					add = 1
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

					owner ?= {
						OR = {
							country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LHASA
							overlord ?= {
								country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LHASA

					}
				}

			}

	s:STATE_PYONGYANG = {
		random_scope_state = {
			owner ?= {
				var:nesnd_uni_head ?= {
					save_scope_as = nesnd_uni_region_head
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
				any_scope_state = {
					count = all
					owner ?= {
						has_variable = nesnd_uni_head
						var:nesnd_uni_head = scope:nesnd_uni_region_head
					}
				}
			}
			scope:nesnd_uni_region_head = {
				change_variable = {
					name = nesnd_uni_held
					add = 1
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner ?= {
						OR = {
							country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_PYONGYANG
							overlord ?= {
								country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_PYONGYANG
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_scope_state = {
				set_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
		else = {

				remove_variable = nesnd_uni_counted
			}
		}
